Vacuum Phase Transition Observatory. Investigates theoretical vacuum states and transition risks through established quantum-field models.

This database covers the technology as item 214 entry 94 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (A)" catalog, section "Omega-Class Hypotheses". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

title: Vacuum Phase Transition Observatory - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Investigates theoretical vacuum states and transition risks through established quantum-field models.
body:
Known science foundations of Vacuum Phase Transition Observatory.

The Higgs vacuum may be metastable (Degrassi et al.). Bubble nucleation is calculated in QFT. Cosmic rays already probe high energies — no vacuum decay observed. The 'observatory' investigates theory; there is nothing to observe.

Key quantity check (Higgs vacuum lifetime in years / universe age in years): computed ratio 7.24638e+89 against the reference value, relative error 0.0004998, within the stated tolerance of 0.5. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

Physical and engineering constraints on Vacuum Phase Transition Observatory.

No observable consequences are expected. Transition risk is negligible per cosmic-ray bounds. The research is pure theory.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 200 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is vacuum lifetime vs transition risk at 200 orders of magnitude (vacuum lifetime larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
